full_name: Ravit Reichman | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2009–2010 Humanities Lisa Goldberg Fellow Brown University
bio: Ravit Reichman is an associate professor of English at Brown University, where her research and teaching focus on the relationship between literature and law in the twentieth century, with particular emphasis on psychoanalysis and the traumas of the world wars.
